feedback.text: Shot 1, Pick the target earlier — eyes to the rim. Eyes on the rim before you lift. Score 83.
Shot 2, David, Drive the elbow long on finish (currently 99°). Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~99°). Score 67.
Shot 3, Snap the wrist so fingers point down on the finish. Freeze the finish for 2 counts; don’t drop early. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~94°). Score 65.
Shot 4, Reach up for a taller finish; trim 52° of tilt. Drive the elbow long on finish (currently 101°). Get the forearm more vertical at release (64° off). Score 60.
Shot 5, Reduce the turnout toward the sidelines. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~102°). Score 66.
Shot 6, Get the forearm more vertical at release (50° off). Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~108°). Score 66.
Shot 7, David, Straighten the elbow through the snap; aim ≥ 150°. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~97°). Score 67.
Shot 8, Get the index under the wrist at finish. Hold the follow-through for a full beat. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~105°). Score 66.
Shot 9, Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~93°). Release above the shoulder; lift to ≥ 52° (now 10°). Score 59.
Shot 10, Eyes on the rim before you lift. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~100°). Score 64.
